facts.business: Bharat Seats Limited manufactures automotive seats and components, primarily for Maruti Suzuki India Limited.

auditor.name: S.R. Batliboi & Co. LLP
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on Income Tax Search conducted under Section 132 of the Income Tax Act, 1961 at certain premises of the Company including manufacturing locations and residence of few employees/key managerial personnel.

key_risks: Uncertainty relating to outcome of Income Tax Department search conducted in an earlier year under Section 132 of the Income Tax Act, 1961
Significant judgement and estimate involved in calculation of price variations for revenue recognition
High concentration of sales to Maruti Suzuki India Limited (promoter group entity)
facts.related_party_note: Material transactions with promoter group entities including Maruti Suzuki India Limited (sale of products Rs 1,24,695.64 lakhs, purchases Rs 2,041.08 lakhs), NDR Auto Components Limited (purchases Rs 58,050.81 lakhs), Suzuki Motor Corporation Japan, and Rohit Relan (KMP). Transactions include sales, purchases, rental income, interest expense, remuneration, dividend paid, and advance received.
